accountDescription: Self-spots to Discord servers that use Spotterbot
notSignedIn: Sign in to Discord in Spotterbot's settings first
signInFirst: Sign in with Discord to see the servers you can post spots to.
signInAgain: Spotterbot no longer accepts your sign-in. Sign in to Discord again in Spotterbot's settings
noServers: None of your Discord servers take spots from you yet. Ask a server's admins to add Spotterbot and give you a role that may post
allSkipped: None of your Discord servers take this spot. Most only post QRV and QRT spots
unchecked: Discord didn't say whether you can post in {{count}} server(s); the spot will be tried again
allSwitchedOff: Every Discord server you can post in is switched off
offline: Connect to the internet to see the servers you can post spots to.
serversUnchecked: Discord didn't answer for {{count}} server(s), which may be missing above. Reopen this page in a moment.
helpText:
A server's admins add Spotterbot from [spotterbot.ham2k.net](https://spotterbot.ham2k.net) and run `/spotterbot setup` there to choose the channel spots go to and a role to mention, then `/spotterbot allow` for each role whose members may post.

Once you sign in with Discord, every self-spot you send also goes to each server where you hold one of those roles. Servers you switch off above don't get it. A server that starts using Spotterbot later is switched on.

The same switches are on [spotterbot.ham2k.net](https://spotterbot.ham2k.net/account), where you sign in with Discord. A server's admins can change its setup there too.

Each server decides which spots it takes. Most post only the spots whose comment starts with **QRV** or **QRT**, so the channel hears when you go on and off the air, not every respot.
